paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-seventh day of the third month of Tenshō 12, as Ikeda Shōnyū and Mori Musashi-no-kami Nagayoshi gathered every boat between Kanayama and Inuyama and waited anxiously upon the river, Hideyoshi arrived at the head of a vast army.

units.source_en: On the twenty-seventh day of the third month of Tenshō 12, as Ikeda Shōnyū and Mori Musashi-no-kami Nagayoshi gathered every boat between Kanayama and Inuyama and waited anxiously upon the river, Hideyoshi arrived at the head of a vast army.
units.source_zh: 天正十二年三月二十七，当池田胜入和森武藏守长可把从金山到犬山一带所有船只全部集中起来，停在河面上焦急等待之时，秀吉率领大队人马浩浩荡荡赶来了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天正十二年三月二十七，当池田胜入和森武藏守长可把从金山到犬山一带所有船只全部集中起来，停在河面上焦急等待之时，秀吉率领大队人马浩浩荡荡赶来了。

paragraphs.source_en: That day, not a cloud marked the boundless sky. Yet after the unbroken rain since the nineteenth, the waters of the Kiso River remained exceedingly muddy. Had it not rained, Shōnyū and Musashi-no-kami would probably have gone as far as Ikejiri to meet him and held a council of war there. But the swollen Kiso made it too late to meet him, so at Hideyoshi's command the two men had no choice but to await him where they were.

units.source_zh: 这一日，天空万里无云。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这一日，天空万里无云。由于十九日以来的连日阴雨，木曾川的水流依然非常浑浊。假如没有这场雨，胜入和武藏守恐都要出迎到池尻，并在那里召开军事会议了。但由于木曾川涨水，前去迎接已来不及了，二人只好奉秀吉之命在原地迎候。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus, when Hideyoshi's emblem—the thousand-gourd standard—passed from the boats crowding the river black onto the bank, Shōnyū and Musashi-no-kami could no longer contain their ardor and hurried forward to greet him. Both men apparently shared the same expectation: the instant Hideyoshi entered Inuyama Castle, he would convene a council of war.

units.source_en: Thus, when Hideyoshi's emblem—the thousand-gourd standard—passed from the boats crowding the river black onto the bank, Shōnyū and Musashi-no-kami could no longer contain their ardor and hurried forward to greet him.

units.source_en: Both men apparently shared the same expectation: the instant Hideyoshi entered Inuyama Castle, he would convene a council of war.
